title: Complex Feature Synthesis — Advanced CAD Model Generation
brief: Generate highly advanced CAD models with complex features: multi-body assemblies, sweeps, lofts, patterns, configurations, iLogic rules, parametric drivers, weldments, sheet metal. Handle industrial-grade complexity (JM Die cold-heading dies = thousands of features per part). Output: near-AGI CAD synthesis that a senior designer cannot distinguish from human work.

smart_config.role: Senior CAD Designer + Computational Geometry PhD
Parametric Design Architect + CAD Automation Expert

must_include: Assembly joint types (rigid, revolute, slider, cylindrical, planar, ball, pin-slot)
PRISM precision engineering domain (error budget, Abbe)

session_plan.title: Sheet Metal, Drawings, BOM, Dispatcher Wiring

must_include: Sheet metal bend table (JM Die process sheets)

units.title: AdvancedSweepEngine — multi-rail guided sweeps
units.intent: Generate sweep features: single path, multi-path guided, variable profile, helical. Handle twist control and G2 continuity. Used for cold-header hammer contours, mandrels, complex die cavities.

loops.loop_1_build: Sweep primitive generator. Path validator (G0/G1/G2 continuity detection). Profile interpolator for variable sweep. Twist law resolver.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: CAD geometry PhD + failure mode analyst. Check: self-intersection detection, curvature discontinuity rejection, profile degeneracy handling.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Variable profile interpolation (linear, smooth, by curvature). G3 continuity for show surfaces.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generate 30 die cavity sweeps (helical, variable, guided) — all self-intersection free, G2 continuous.

units.description: AdvancedSweepEngine — multi-rail guided sweeps — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: AdvancedLoftEngine — multi-profile loft with rails
units.intent: Loft feature: N profiles + optional rails + centerline. Support closed loops, tangency conditions at start/end, multi-section ruling. Essential for die transition zones and aerodynamic surfaces.

loops.loop_1_build: Profile consistency checker. Ruling algorithm. Rail curve governor. Boundary condition (natural, tangent, curvature).
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: NURBS expert + differential geometry PhD. Check: profile alignment discipline (consistent direction), smoothness metrics.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Closed loft handling, degenerate profile snap.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 25 loft test cases, 100% valid BRep, mean curvature discontinuity < 0.01 mm⁻¹.

units.description: AdvancedLoftEngine — multi-profile loft with rails — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: BoundarySurfaceEngine — N-boundary surface construction
units.intent: Build boundary/patch surfaces from N edges with tangent/curvature constraints. Used for show surface construction, die flow surfaces, custom ergonomic handles.

loops.loop_1_build: Coons patch + Gordon surface algorithms. Boundary condition propagation.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Computational geometry expert. Check: blending quality, boundary honoring.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 15 boundary surfaces with tangent/curvature boundaries — < 0.02mm deviation from constraint.

units.description: BoundarySurfaceEngine — N-boundary surface construction — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: FreeformSurfaceSculptEngine — T-spline/SubD synthesis
units.intent: Freeform SubD / T-spline sculpting for organic shapes. Fusion360-style 'Form' environment. Useful for ergonomic cold-heading punches, operator fixtures.

loops.loop_1_build: SubD mesh primitive + Catmull-Clark refinement + T-spline conversion. Control cage editor.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: SubD expert + CAD geometry PhD. Check: star vertex handling, degree preservation.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 10 organic shapes → convertible to NURBS BRep for downstream CAM.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If NURBS conversion fails > 10%, document limitation.

units.title: PatternSynthesisEngine — linear/circular/sketch-driven/reference
units.intent: Generate pattern features: linear (1-2 direction), circular, mirror, sketch-driven (from point pattern), reference (driven by other feature). Handle variable count, spacing, and skip instances.

loops.loop_1_build: Pattern type dispatcher. Skip-instance logic. Reference-pattern dependency tracking.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Parametric CAD expert. Check: instance interference detection, edge-case count (n=1, n=0).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 100 pattern test cases (5 types x 20 configs), 100% valid.

loops.loop_1_build: Configuration data model. Feature suppression map. Dimension override resolver. Config switching API.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: CAD configuration expert + code-reviewer. Check: dependency resolution order, stale config detection.

loops.loop_1_build: Rule DSL parser (if/then/else, arithmetic, string ops). Dependency graph. Topological rule execution order.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Parametric expert + formal methods reviewer. Check: termination guarantee, circular dep detection, solver correctness.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: External rule invocation (call another rule/script), rule versioning.

loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Multi-body CAD expert. Check: body merge correctness, interference/overlap detection.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 15 multi-body parts (2–5 bodies each), 100% boolean success, 0 topology errors.
